$comment: Inputs of script/outdated.ts. `holds` lists every dependency that is deliberately not at its newest release, with the reason; `npm run outdated` fails for any other outdated dependency and for a hold whose reason no longer applies. `tools` maps the version variables of the workflows to the GitHub repository whose newest release they must pin. Holds checked against the registries on 2026-10-28.

node.reason: The action runs on the `node24` runtime of the GitHub Actions runner (action.yml `runs.using`); the newest runner (v2.338.2) offers no newer Node.js runtime, and ECS-REQ-002 requires Node.js 24 LTS. Development and CI run the newest Node.js 24 release (.node-version); CI also runs the tests on the newest Node.js.

@types/node.reason: The type definitions must describe the Node.js 24 runtime the action executes on (ECS-REQ-002); @types/node 26 would type-check APIs that do not exist at run time.

typescript.reason: TypeScript 7 (the native port) ships no JavaScript compiler API. typescript-eslint 8.72.1 requires `typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0` and @stryker-mutator/typescript-checker uses the compiler API.
